description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers asking to work through a file (or the whole directory) someone dropped in agents/tmp/ — analysing it against the current tree and turning what survives into a roadmap. Should-not-trigger covers the near-miss neighbours that each own a different surface: /analyze:reference-repo (an EXTERNAL repo, not a local dropped file), /roadmap:create (authoring a roadmap from a request the user states directly, with no artifact to verify), /optimize:project (sweeping the repo's own roadmaps and ADRs, not an inbox artifact), plain file reading with no adoption question, and /memory:mine-session (extracting lessons from a session transcript into memory, not into roadmaps).

queries.q: analysiere die Dateien in agents/tmp und mach Roadmaps draus
work through the inbox — analyse each dropped file and tell me what's still relevant
analyse agents/tmp/better-frontend.txt in detail and follow its instructions
someone dropped a review in tmp — is any of it still true, and what should we adopt?
triage the inbox: which of these files are already implemented and which need work?
analyse the competitor repo at github.com/foo/bar and compare it to ours
create a roadmap for adding OAuth to the login flow
run a deep optimization pass over this project's roadmaps and ADRs
read agents/tmp/notes.txt and tell me what it says
mine this session for lessons and write them to memory
